message Episode {
	required binary episode_id (STRING);
	required binary tenant (STRING);
	optional binary group_id (STRING);
	optional binary task_type (STRING);
	required binary source (STRING);
	optional binary instrumentation (STRING);
	optional binary instrumentation_version (STRING);
	required group entity_keys (LIST) {
		repeated group list {
			required group element {
				required binary name (STRING);
				required binary value (STRING);
			}
		}
	}
	required binary status (ENUM);
	optional group fidelity {
		required boolean has_params;
		required boolean has_token_spans;
		required boolean has_tool_versions;
	}
	optional binary sampled_by (STRING);
	required int64 started_at (TIMESTAMP(isAdjustedToUTC=true,unit=MICROS));
	optional int64 ended_at (TIMESTAMP(isAdjustedToUTC=true,unit=MICROS));
	required int64 received_at (TIMESTAMP(isAdjustedToUTC=true,unit=MICROS));
	required int32 step_count (INT(32,true));
	optional group error {
		required binary type (STRING);
		required binary message (STRING);
	}
	required binary schema_version (STRING);
	optional group raw (MAP) {
		repeated group key_value {
			required binary key (STRING);
			required binary value (STRING);
		}
	}
}
